steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Head to Oo'glog and talk to Chief Tess.

actions.text: What exactly is going on around here?

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Continue talking to Chief Tess.

actions.text: So, about this 'business venture'...

steps.text: Talk to Balnea in the Oo'glog bank.

actions.text: Um, yes. So, what's going on around here?
What's the problem?
Okay, I'll bite. Tell me more.
But of course!
Well, why not? I've nothing better to do.
Sure thing.

steps.title: The food
steps.text: Talk to Chargurr north of the bank.

actions.text: I think I could get that stuff for you.

steps.text: Talk to Chargurr again.
Talk to Chargurr yet again.

actions.text: Fine, I'll get some spears for you

steps.text: Talk to Chargurr once again.

actions.text: Yes, I'd like to give 4 spears to Chargurr.

steps.text: Talk to Chargurr (again).

actions.text: But of course! I'll bring you some chompy birds.

steps.text: Use two raw chompies on Chargurr.
Talk to Chargurr.
Light the fire pit.
Talk to Chargurr.

steps.title: The beds
steps.text: Talk to Balnea.

actions.text: Right-ho. I'll go and see Snurgh at the hotel and 'transition' away.

steps.text: Talk to Snurgh to the east.

actions.text: Sure, I'll bring you some feathers.

steps.text:
Talk to Snurgh with the stripy feathers.
  • Catch tropical wagtails near the Oo'glog lodestone for stripy feathers.

steps.title: The salon
steps.text: Talk to Balnea.

actions.text: You're going to ask me to go to the salon, right?
Yeah, sure, I'll go to the salon.

steps.text: Talk to Kringk to the east.

actions.text: Why, sure, I'd be happy to help.

steps.text:
Talk to Kringk with the furs and bones.
  • Catch larupias north of the Oo'glog lodestone.
  • Kill wolves west of Oo'glog.

actions.text: You sure can!

steps.title: First trial
steps.text: Talk to Balnea.
Talk to Seegud.
Use a eucalyptus log on the fire pit.

postconditions.text: eucalyptus logs in the fire pit

steps.text: Use tansymum on the fire pit.
Light the fire pit.
Talk to Seegud.

actions.text: I think I'm a little stuck.
Can you explain what I should be doing again?

steps.text: Talk to Snarrk.

steps.title: Pest control
steps.text:
Use logs and plants on the fire pits to disperse the bugs and find which plant corresponds to which rock.
  • You have to remember which stone corresponds to which plant.
  • Plant numbers are estimates.
  • The wiki has a nice calculator for this section.
Thermal bath - yellow egg-shaped rock.
Mud bath - red sphere rock. Add the yellow egg-shaped plant too.
Salt-water spring - green gumdrop rock. Add the red sphere plant too.
Sulphur spring - purple tall rock. Add the green gumdrop plant too.
Bandos pool - orange squarish rock. Add the red sphere and purple tall plants too.
Return to Seegud.

steps.title: The animals
steps.text: Talk to Balnea.

actions.text: Sure, anything to avoid talking to you for a while.

steps.text: Talk to Chief Tess.

actions.text: Talk about As a First Resort quest.
I know how to smoke a trap to remove my scent.

steps.title: Kebbits
steps.text: Set the boulder traps east of the salt-water pool.
Light fever grass.
Run around the trap with the lit fever grass.
Do this until all 2 kebbits are caught.
Repeat the steps on the west side of the salt-water pool.
Light fever grass.
Run around the trap with the lit fever grass.
Do this until all 2 kebbits are caught.

steps.title: Wimpy birds
steps.text: Set up a bird snare west of the bank.
Light a tansymum from the inventory and move around.
Run around the trap until a bird is caught.
Do this until all birds are caught.

steps.title: Platypodes
steps.text: Setup a box trap on the marked tile.
Burn lavender.
Move around the area until a platypode is caught.
Catch all 4 platypodes.
Stand next to the plants in the water to the east.
Release the platypodes.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Talk to Balnea.
Watch the cutscene.

postconditions.text: feel free to use the pools

steps.text: Talk to Balnea.
